quarterly_data.signal: Wistron investor deck (08-04-2026): AI was 78% of 1H26 revenue. 1H26 net revenue NT$1,741,746 million (+94.0% YoY), operating income NT$62,585 million (+141.3%), PAT NT$24,458 million (+106.6%). 2Q26 net revenue NT$895,443 million (+5.8% QoQ) with a realized gross margin of 5.66% (1Q26: 5.21%), operating income NT$33,447 million (3.74% margin) and PAT NT$14,827 million. Inventory fell to NT$532,898 million at 2026-06-30 from NT$611,556 million at 2026-03-31. The deck describes Wistron's AI offering as L6 compute tray, L10 full rack delivery and L11 (NVIDIA standard + customized solutions) for CSPs (NVIDIA, AMD, ASIC and general server) and enterprise AI, plus components and new products (GPU, LPU, CPU, storage, switch); engineers rose to 7,400.
